contenu:
name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

extends:
  template: "jobs/megalinter.yml@pipelines"
  parameters:
    megalinter_image_name: oxsecurity/megalinter-formatters
    megalinter_configuration:
      - name: DISABLE
        value: SPELL
    publish_to_sonarqube: true

parameters:
- name: force_publish
  displayName: 'Force publish of the npm package when branch is not "main"'
  type: boolean
  default: false

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

jobs:
- job: 'publish_npm_package'
  pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
  steps:
  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: .npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate Private npm Registry

  - script: |
      npm install -D
    displayName: Install npm Dependencies

  - script: |
      npm audit
    displayName: Check For Vulnerable Dependencies

  - script: |
      npm publish
    displayName: Publish npm Package
    condition: ${{ or(eq(parameters.force_publish, true), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')) }}
